name: workflow-controller
command: env -u PI_ROOT_SESSION_ID -u PI_SCRATCH_DIR -u PI_SESSION_ID -u PI_CODING_AGENT -u PI_MANAGED_INSTALL_ROOT node --test tests/prop-workflow-controller.test.ts

assumes.note: The fake runner settles each run exactly once and ignores the abort signal; the real runner bridge is assumed to settle its promise once and to reject or return cancelled after abort.
Provider-unavailable errors use the message format parsed by providerKeyFromUnavailableMessage.
Not exercised: step timeout_ms timers and workflow_update (updateSteps); graphs are limited to 6 steps, 3 needs per step, maxConcurrent 1-3.
Observations happen after a setImmediate flush, so properties hold at macrotask boundaries, not between microtasks.
